data_execution.training_order: task order, then ascending demo index, then reader position; batch indices cycle modulo 480

stochastic_execution.adapter_initialization: reset to stable_seed(seed, adapter_initialization) before every arm so all arms start bit-identically
stochastic_execution.t_schedule: within every effective batch, t_j=(j+0.5)/8 for j=0..7
stochastic_execution.epsilon_schedule: one CUDA generator per exposure, seeded by stable_seed(seed, exposure_ordinal, task_key, demo_index, reader_position); independent of arm
stochastic_execution.validation_noise: stable_seed(seed, validation, task_key, demo_index, reader_position); independent of arm
stochastic_execution.validation_t_schedule: one row at a time with effective t offset equal to validation row index modulo 8
stochastic_execution.generation_noise: stable_seed(seed, validation_generation, task_key, demo_index, reader_position); independent of policy

optimization.no_reconstruction_loss: full loss with reconstruction coefficient exactly 0
optimization.no_raw_gripper_margin_loss: full loss with raw gripper coefficient exactly 0
optimization.generic_loss: position_loss/500 + rotate6D_loss/10 + gripper_loss from official EE6DActionSpace.compute_loss(student_raw, demonstration_action)

validation.clean_bypass: hook deactivated; matched clean plan must have exact zero raw and postprocessed delta
validation.official_range: all outputs finite and postprocessed gripper channels in [0,1]; official EE6DActionSpace defines no additional continuous clamp
validation.smoothness: aggregate adjacent-step p99 for translation and rotation must not exceed the frozen clean-teacher envelopes
validation.latency: 10 warmups plus 100 measured fixed-input queries per Base and trainable arm; total synchronized wall time and adapter-only CUDA-event time

decision_mapping.execution_or_resource_failure: any missing real forward, nonfinite/zero gradient, wrong optimizer count, unchanged weight, checkpoint/reload failure, frozen-backbone guard drift, split drift, resource ceiling breach, swap growth, or exception
decision_mapping.action_legality_failure: any nonfinite output, official range violation, nonzero clean-bypass delta, or full-method translation/rotation p99 outside the frozen smoothness envelope
decision_mapping.practical_pass_per_metric: comparator error minus full error is at least 5% of comparator error and at least the frozen absolute threshold
decision_mapping.other_metric_nonregression: full error is no more than comparator error plus max(2% of comparator error, 10 times frozen repeat noise)
decision_mapping.gripper_nonregression: full has no more discrete validation gripper disagreements to the clean teacher than the comparator
decision_mapping.reconstruction_gate: full wrist reconstruction MSE <=0.95 times no-reconstruction overall and lower on at least two tasks
decision_mapping.base_directional_gate: full has lower mean denominator-normalized teacher-agreement error than Base and improves at least one co-primary metric
decision_mapping.STAGE0_GO: execution and legality pass; full-vs-no-reconstruction and full-vs-generic each pass practical, other-metric, and gripper gates; reconstruction and Base directional gates pass; at least one practically passing metric against each comparator has paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0
decision_mapping.STAGE0_PROMISING_NEEDS_ONE_FIXED_CONFIRM: all noncatastrophic execution/legality/Base/reconstruction gates pass and point estimates are practically positive but a required paired CI remains unresolved, or all four no-reconstruction improvements are positive but subthreshold
decision_mapping.STAGE0_UNDERPOWERED_ONE_FIXED_EXPANSION_: execution/legality/Base pass and at least one no-reconstruction point improvement is positive with no material other-metric or gripper regression, but effects are mixed or below the practical boundary
decision_mapping.STAGE0_GENERIC_ADAPTATION_EXPLAINS_GAIN: full-vs-no-reconstruction mechanism gate passes but the matched generic comparator practical gate fails
decision_mapping.STAGE0_MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED: valid legal execution without the conditions for GO, promising confirmation, underpowered expansion, or generic-explanation classification
